query:
SELECT 'Senate' as chamber, state_name, is_special, primary_winner, primary_party, status, primary_date
FROM senate_races
WHERE primary_winner IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY state_name;

SELECT 'House' as chamber, CONCAT(state_code, '-', district_label) as race, primary_winner, primary_party, status, primary_date
FROM house_races
WHERE primary_winner IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY state_code, district;

SELECT 'Governor' as chamber, state_name, primary_winner, primary_party, status, primary_date
FROM governor_races
WHERE primary_winner IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY state_name;
